extName.message: Header Relay — HTTP Request Header Modifier & Response Header Capture

extDescription.message: Capture HTTP response headers and relay fixed or captured headers to matching browser requests.

popupNoEditableHeaders.message: No headers are editable for this page

popupEnableProfileHint.message: Enable the profile to attach headers

popupCreateProfileHint.message: Create a profile in Profile management to start relaying headers.

profileNameDuplicate.message: A profile with this name already exists.

profileSettingsDescription.message: Rename, duplicate, or delete the selected profile.

profileEnabledDescription.message: Disabled profiles do not capture or attach headers. Disabling a profile also clears its captured values.

profileDeleteConfirm.message: Delete profile "$1"? Its captured values will also be removed.

settingsDescription.message: Configure settings shared by every Header Relay screen.

settingsCompactDescription.message: Use denser spacing and smaller controls throughout the extension.

settingsPrivacyDescription.message: Review how Header Relay handles configuration, captured values, and audit logs.

advancedSettingsDescription.message: Run URL probes, review audit activity, or edit the complete configuration JSON.

activeHeadersDescription.message: Headers that will be attached when this profile matches the request URL.

capturedPanelDescription.message: Latest response header values stored in the current extension session.

clearCapturedValuesDescription.message: Clear removes current captured values but keeps this profile and its header settings. Disabling the profile also clears these values.

originsDescription.message: Origins where header emulation is allowed. Requests outside these origins are ignored.

originsPermissionNote.message: Saving requests host access for the origins you added. Access covers every port on that host, is used only for this extension's header relay, and can be revoked anytime from Chrome's extension settings.

revokeOrphanedConfirm.message:
These host permissions are no longer used by any profile:
$1
Revoke them now?

fixedDescription.message: Names and values are stored in extension-local settings until you remove them. Enabled values are attached only to matching requests and are not sent elsewhere.

captureDescription.message: Only these names are read from matching responses. Values stay in memory for the current browser session, are reused only on matching requests, and are cleared on browser restart, profile disable, or rule changes.

sensitiveHeaderWarning.message: Sensitive header: its value may contain credentials. Use test credentials and limit Target Origins.

cookieHeaderWarning.message: Sensitive header: overriding Cookie can conflict with Chrome's cookie store and authentication state. Limit Target Origins and use test data.

blockedHeaderWarning.message: Unavailable: response-only, request authority, message framing, proxy, and connection headers cannot be relayed safely.

excludeDescription.message: Glob patterns inside target origins where emulator-managed headers are removed.

excludedPathHelp.message: Enter a whole-path glob such as /assets/**. Use * within a single path segment, ** across segments, and ? for one character. The pattern must match the entire pathname, so /assets matches only /assets — use /assets/** for everything beneath it. Query strings and fragments are ignored, and rules apply only inside target origins.

excludedPathMustStartWithSlash.message: Enter a path that starts with /.

excludedPathUrlNotAllowed.message: Enter a path such as /assets/**, not a full URL.

excludedPathSingleLine.message: Enter the path on one line.

excludedPathRootWarning.message: /** excludes every URL inside this profile's target origins.

excludedPathTesterDescription.message: Test a real URL against the current unsaved profile draft.

probeDescription.message: Check whether a URL is matched, excluded, and which request headers would be attached before visiting it.

probeTestedUrlDesc.message: The normalized URL evaluated from this draft.

probeAllowedDesc.message: Yes means at least one enabled profile attaches a header to this URL.

auditDescription.message: Runtime history for URL matches, header capture, session changes, and DNR rule sync. Request URLs are kept in memory only for the current browser session and are never saved to disk.

advancedDescription.message: Direct JSON editor for advanced config inspection and recovery.

configReplaceConfirm.message: This will replace the entire existing configuration. Continue?

compileWarningNoTargetOrigins.message: Profile "$1" has no enabled target origin.

compileWarningExcludedPathsRemoveHeaders.message: Profile "$1" removes its own relay-managed headers on excluded paths.

compileWarningCookieExclusion.message: Cookie rules are skipped on $1: the excluded paths ($2) cannot keep the browser's own Cookie, so it is sent unchanged on this origin.

compileErrorHeaderConflict.message: Header "$1" on $2 is set by more than one enabled profile ($3). Disable all but one.

compileErrorCookieConflict.message: Cookie "$1" on $2 is set by more than one enabled profile ($3). Disable all but one.

runtimeStatusDescription.message: How all enabled profiles are currently applied in the browser.

probeNoMatchedProfiles.message: No enabled profile matches this URL.

probeMatchedProfileCountDesc.message: Enabled profiles whose target origin matches this URL.

probeEffectiveHeadersDesc.message: Header names actually attached to the request after excluded paths and conflicts.

probeCookieHeaderDesc.message: The final Cookie header value sent to the target URL, or `none` when Chrome's original Cookie passes through unchanged.

cookiesDescription.message: Cookies to attach to requests. Fixed cookies always apply; tracked cookies capture values from Set-Cookie responses.

clearAllTrackedCookiesConfirm.message: Clear every tracked cookie value for this profile?

migrationIssuesDescription.message: Legacy Cookie header settings that could not be migrated automatically. Delete them once you have reconfigured cookies below.

migrationIssueReasonPopupMismatch.message: Popup select options could not be reproduced.

migrationIssueReasonParseFail.message: Cookie value could not be parsed.

migrationIssueReasonCapture.message: A captured Cookie header has no unambiguous target name.

popupNoMatchHint.message: Add this site's origin to a profile to relay headers here.

popupUnsupportedPage.message: Header Relay applies only to http and https pages.

runtimeStaleRules.message: Extension rules could not update. Previous ruleset is still active — refresh may fix this.

runtimeStaleFailedRules.message: Warning: DNR update AND remove-only retry both failed. Stale rules may still be sent.

rateOnStore.message: Rate on the Chrome Web Store

reviewPromptRateBody.message: A review on the Chrome Web Store helps other developers find it.
